workReports.title: Workforce reports
workReports.description: Attendance, leave, Earned Leave, tasks, goals, holidays, probation and more. You only see people in your scope.

filters.rangeBad: The start date must not be after the end date.

help.attendance: One row per employee per day in the range.
help.leave: Leave requests that overlap the range.
help.earned-leave: Every Earned Leave credit and balance change with its calculation.
help.tasks: Tasks assigned in the range with status and due dates.
help.goals: Goals active in the range with progress and risk.
help.holidays: Approved and suggested holidays in the range.
help.probation: Probation end dates and decisions. Default range: last 30 to next 90 days.
help.birthdays: Upcoming birthdays (HR and Founder only). Birth year and age are never included.
help.department-performance: Attendance, task and goal results grouped by department or manager.
help.weekly-progress: One row per person: attendance, late joins, their own end-of-day work reports, tasks done and goal progress. Default range: this week, Monday to today.
help.new-joiners: People who joined in the last 90 days: day of 90, training done, tasks, attendance and goal progress. Default range: joined in the last 90 days.

workReports.emptyBody: Try a wider date range. Empty cells in a report mean not applicable, never zero.
workReports.truncated: Only the first {n} rows are included. Narrow the date range or filters to see the rest.

export.done: Export downloaded: {n} rows. The export is logged.
export.doneTruncated: Export downloaded with only {n} rows (row limit reached).
